title: Normalized descent of coefficient transitions
statement: Let $J,O,\ell,B_n$ and $\mathsf S_B$ be as in the strict semilinear system construction [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension], with independently chosen ordinary unbounded derived categories. Fix strict transitions $\tau_{mn}:e_m\to e_nR_{mn}$ for $n\leq m$, derived evaluations and their localization factors [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-core], and exact derived restrictions with their localization factors [lem-pur-coefficient-scalar-derived-adjunction]. There is a natural transformation $t_{mn}:e_m\to e_nR_{mn}$ on derived categories. At every system complex $K$, composing $t_{mn,QK}$ with derived restriction of the $n$-evaluation factor and then with the restriction factor equals the $m$-evaluation factor followed by $Q$ of the strict termwise transition. Thus it descends the specified strict transition, rather than an arbitrary transformation with the same source and target.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Compose the m-evaluation localization comparison, the localized termwise strict transition, the inverse restriction comparison and the inverse n-evaluation comparison, inserting functor associators. This gives a transformation after precomposing by system localization.

Precomposition by a localization is fully faithful. Take its preimage transformation. Evaluate the preimage equation at a complex and cancel the restriction and evaluation comparison isomorphisms; functoriality identifies the resulting composite with the normalized equation.

theorem coefficientEvaluationDerivedTransition
    (ordinary : CoefficientOrdinaryEvaluationData (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell))
    [∀ n, (ordinary.extension n).Additive]
    (scalar : CoefficientScalarDerivedAssignment (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell))
    (core : CoefficientEvaluationDerivedCoreData ordinary) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∃ t : core.evaluation m ⟶ core.evaluation n ⋙ (scalar h).restriction,
      ∀ K, t.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
        (scalar h).restriction.map ((core.evaluationFactors n).hom.app K) ≫
        (scalar h).restrictionFactors.hom.app
          (((coefficientEvaluation (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) n).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
        (core.evaluationFactors m).hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (ordinary.strictTransition h) (.up ℤ)).app K)
